note: Inkling-NVFP4 TP8/EP8 additions: QKVR GEMM positions the Small TP4 rules miss (prefix-end layer-0 GEMM, q/rel-stream GEMM before _q_kernel, split-K reduces).

rules.name: nvjet_sm100
rules.note: Layer-0 QKVR GEMM, the first GEMM after log_scaling_tau. When the layers fold into a repeat body that starts at _kv_kernel, this GEMM ends the prefix and has no before_name neighbour. Mapped nvjet after log_scaling_tau: 212/212 qkvr_proj.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100
rules.note: QKVR GEMM of the layer after a dense FFN layer (it follows the FFN's RS/sconv/AG norm). Mapped nvjet after ffn.rs_sconv_ag_norm: 212/212 qkvr_proj.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100
rules.note: QKVR GEMM of the layer after a MoE layer. Mapped nvjet after moe.rs_sconv_ag_norm: 1176/1176 qkvr_proj.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100
rules.note: QKVR GEMM launched on the q/rel stream: at some TP8 batch sizes vLLM issues it on the concurrent track, right before _q_kernel.

rules.name: splitKreduce_kernel
rules.note: QKVR split-K reduce on the q/rel stream, right before _q_kernel.

rules.name: splitKreduce_kernel
rules.note: QKVR split-K reduce right before _kv_kernel (TP8 picks split-K at small T).

rules.name: splitKreduce_kernel
rules.note: QKVR split-K reduce that ends a folded body: its GEMM is the last mapped kernel before it and nothing follows.
